name: Snob
text: Game end: +1 follower per blue member you have.

name: Trendsetter
text: Whenever you recruit a member, send 1 shop member to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Window Dresser
text: On Recruit: send 3 shop members to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Window Shopper
text: On Recruit: send 1 shop member to the bottom of the pile, gain 1 of its color. Round Start: send 1 shop member to the bottom of the pile, gain 1 of its color.

name: Broker
text: Whenever a White action gives you followers, +1 follower.

name: Cashier
text: On Recruit: turn all your white into followers.

name: Money Changer
text: Whenever you turn resources or members into followers, +1 white.

name: Exporter
text: Whenever you recruit a non-white member, +1 white.

name: Heiress
text: Once per game: +1 white per member you have.

name: Hoarder
text: Once per game: turn all your resources into white.

name: Martyr
text: When this member leaves your cult, gain followers equal to its cost.

name: Old Money
text: Game end: +1 follower per white member you have.

name: Raiders
text: Once per game: steal 4 followers from the leader. Pay them 2 white.

name: Recluse
text: Game end: +2 followers per rival with more members than you.

name: Shopkeeper
text: On Recruit: +2 white. Round Start: +2 white.

name: Undertaker
text: Whenever you cast out one of your members, +2 followers.

name: Anarchist
text: Once per round: swap any two members within 2 cost.

name: Big Spender
text: Once per game: recruit twice this turn.

name: Cheerleader
text: Whenever you win a contest, +1 follower.

name: Con Men
text: Counts as 2 members. On Recruit: steal 5 resources.

name: Dabblers
text: Counts as 2 members of every color.

name: Extra Hand
text: Once per game: +1 minion this round.
